# Reactive State and Callbacks

Agent Smith uses Vue's `ref` and `reactive` for cross-module state management, and a comprehensive callback system for real-time inference event streaming. The callback interfaces are defined in `@agent-smith/types` and consumed by the agent loop, Lm client, and WebSocket server.

## State Management

The `@agent-smith/core` package exports reactive state objects (`state`, `conf`, `db`, `fs`) that use Vue's reactivity system. This allows any module — CLI, server, or browser UI — to subscribe to configuration changes without polling.

## Callback Interfaces

Three callback interfaces are defined in `packages/types/src/callbacks.ts`:

### InferenceCallbacks

Events from the LLM inference stream:

```typescript
interface InferenceCallbacks {
    onStartThinking?: (from: string) => void;
    onEndThinking?: (from: string) => void;
    onToken?: (t: string, from: string) => void;
    onThinkingToken?: (t: string, from: string) => void;
    onToolCallToken?: (t: string, from: string) => void;
    onStartEmit?: (data: PromptProcessingInProgressStats, from: string) => void;
    onEndEmit?: (result: InferenceResult, from: string) => void;
    onError?: (err: any, from: string) => void;
    onToolCallInProgress?: (tc: Array<ToolCallSpec>, from: string) => void;
    onPromptProcessingProgress?: (progress: PromptProcessingInProgressStats, from: string) => void;
}
```

### AgentCallbacks

Events from the agent's tool-calling loop:

```typescript
interface AgentCallbacks {
    onToolCall?: (tc: ToolCallSpec, type: string, from: string) => void;
    onToolCallEnd?: (tc: ToolCallSpec, tr: any, type: string, from: string) => void;
    onToolsTurnStart?: (tc: Array<ToolCallSpec>, from: string) => void;
    onToolsTurnEnd?: (tt: Array<ToolTurn>, from: string) => void;
    onTurnStart?: (from: string) => void;
    onTurnEnd?: (ht: HistoryTurn, from: string) => void;
    onAssistant?: (txt: string, from: string) => void;
    onThink?: (txt: string, from: string) => void;
}
```

### AllCallbacks

The combined interface used for server and full-agent contexts:

```typescript
interface AllCallbacks extends InferenceCallbacks, AgentCallbacks { }
```

## Callback Usage in the Agent Class

The `Agent` class from `@agent-smith/agent` accepts callbacks via its constructor:

```typescript
import { Agent, Lm } from "@agent-smith/agent";
import type { AllCallbacks, ToolCallSpec, HistoryTurn } from "@agent-smith/types";

const lm = new Lm({ model: "gpt-4", apiKey: "..." });
const agent = new Agent(
    {
        lm,
        name: "my-agent",
        onToken: (token, from) => process.stdout.write(token),
        onThinkingToken: (token, from) => console.log("[thinking]", token),
        onToolCall: (tc, type, from) => console.log("Tool:", tc.name),
        onToolCallEnd: (tc, result, type, from) => console.log("Result:", result),
        onTurnStart: (from) => console.log("=== New turn ==="),
        onTurnEnd: (ht, from) => console.log("Turn complete"),
        onAssistant: (txt, from) => console.log(txt),
    },
    agentSpec
);

const result = await agent.run("Hello, world!");
```

The `Lm` client handles inference-level callbacks (`onToken`, `onThinkingToken`, `onStartEmit`, `onEndEmit`, `onError`, `onToolCallInProgress`), while the `Agent` class handles agent-level callbacks (`onToolCall`, `onTurnEnd`, `onAssistant`, etc.).

## WebSocket Protocol

The server streams inference events over WebSocket at `/ws`. Clients connect using `useWsServer()` from `@agent-smith/wscli`, which provides auto-reconnect. The server sends typed messages defined in `WsServerMsgType`:

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `error` | Error message |
| `startemit` | Inference started with processing stats |
| `token` | Generated token |
| `thinkingtoken` | Thinking/reasoning token |
| `turnstart` | New conversation turn began |
| `turnend` | Turn completed with HistoryTurn |
| `assistant` | Assistant text output |
| `think` | Model thinking content |
| `thinkingstart` / `thinkingend` | Thinking block boundaries |
| `toolcallinprogress` | Tool execution in progress |
| `promptprocessingprogress` | Prompt processing stats |
| `toolcalltoken` | Token from tool call |
| `toolsturnstart` / `toolsturnend` | Tools turn boundaries |
| `toolcall` / `toolcallend` | Tool call lifecycle |
| `toolcallconfirm` | Awaiting tool confirmation |
| `finalresult` | Final inference result |
| `endemit` | Inference complete |

Clients send messages via `WsClientMsg`:

```typescript
interface WsClientMsg {
    command: string;
    type: 'command' | 'system';
    feature?: FeatureType;
    payload?: any;
    options?: Record<string, any>;
}
```

## ServerParams

The server accepts callback parameters through `ServerParams`, which extends `AllCallbacks`:

```typescript
interface ServerParams extends AllCallbacks {
    url?: string;                          // WebSocket URL (default: ws://localhost:5184/ws)
    isVerbose?: boolean;
    defaultInferenceParams?: InferenceParams;
    onConfirmToolUsage?: (tool: ToolCallSpec) => Promise<boolean>;
}
```

The `onConfirmToolUsage` callback enables supervised execution — the server prompts the user before each tool call, and the callback returns `true` to allow or `false` to deny execution.
